hookups.source: https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Pine-Log-State-Forest ('All sites are fully equipped with electric and water hook-ups') + ReserveAmerica campsiteDetails for all 20 RV-or-tent sites (Electricity Hookup 30/50), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 20 RV-or-tent sites, site 1 being the camp host's; ReserveAmerica lists 23-42 ft (most 37-42), five pull-through.

sites.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/sand-pond-campground-pine-log-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120116 (site list: 20 'RV or Tent' + the pavilion; 'Campsite #1 belongs to the Camp Host') + each site's campsiteDetails (Max Vehicle Length 23-42, Access Type Back-In / Pull-Thru), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Fishing pier and a reservable picnic pavilion; a separate youth group camp.

facilities.source: https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Pine-Log-State-Forest ('Restrooms with showers and a sanitary dumping station are located on-site') + ReserveAmerica campground page ('sites with electric and water (potable), restrooms and showers, pavilion, fishing pier and dump station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The Florida Forest Service closes all state forest campgrounds when the county is under a tropical storm or hurricane warning (reservations refunded).

season.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/sand-pond-campground-pine-log-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120116 ('Status: Open year round', 'The Florida Forest Service will close all campgrounds and recreation areas on State Forests if the county ... is placed under a Tropical Storm or Hurricane WARNING'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations on the Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica site or at 1-877-879-3859, for the same day up to 11 months ahead.

booking.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/sand-pond-campground-pine-log-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120116 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance') + https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Pine-Log-State-Forest ('To purchase a pass or make a reservation, visit ReserveAmerica or call 1-877-879-3859'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Florida Forest Service camping discounts for people 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and the 100% disabled; the documentation must be registered with the ReserveAmerica call center (877-879-3859) before booking.

discounts.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/sand-pond-campground-pine-log-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120116 ('The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for individuals age 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and for individuals 100% disabled at applicable camping facilities on Florida's State Forests'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florida Forest Service campground in Pine Log State Forest, Florida's first state forest. --Claude
